source_row.extraction_instructions: Modern Events Calendar list skin: month dividers ('November 2026') then article cards with year-less dates ('04 - 27 Jan'); the year comes from the divider. No load-more control renders and /wp-json/mec/v1/events returns []. Detail pages hold a 'Book Event' ticket block (name, price with or without GBP sign, 'Available Tickets: N') and a JSON-LD Event; the hidden 'ticket is sold out' sentence under every ticket is a template, not a signal. Webinars are online; the congress sells tickets on pccongress.org.uk (PDF price list).

concerns: Listing shows 7 upcoming events and no load-more control (MEC renders one only when more exist); recon's '9+' was not reproducible. MEC REST route returns []; the WP REST mec-events route lists 46 posts but carries no event dates, so it cannot be used for completeness.

JSON-LD offers on MEC pages are the first ticket only (or a blank cost rendered as 0): ignored, tiers come from the 'Book Event' block. Tickets with no price and a 'FREE to attend' note become GBP 0. is_sold_out is only set if every ticket says 'Available Tickets: 0'.

Palliative Care Congress 2027: no fee on apmonline.org; tickets on pccongress.org.uk/buy-pcc-tickets and a PDF price list (filesusr.com). organiser_url is the ticket page; the explorer's PDF reader should pick up the price list. CPD 'being sought' so no points.
Ethics Course early-bird deadline is not stated on the page, so early_bird_deadline is empty. Webinars have no venue by design (format online); APM Juniors/online series are classed as workshop.

Coverage checklist: (1) multi-day: listing ranges kept as end_date; (2) external fee links: organiser_url set from the Register/Visit link; (3) image fee tables: none seen; (4) same-site registration sub-pages: see per-source note; (5) two-hop: organiser_url handed to explorer; (6) poster competitions: none; (7) call-for-papers/portals left to the merge step (harness coverage shows SUBMISSION_NO_DEADLINE as expected); (8) no CTA text in tier labels.
